title: Refuse handoff while background agents are still running
body:
Outcome: krn-handoff refuses to launch a successor while the session has live background agents (f79475b2 launched with 2 recons in flight and kept working).
Metric re-run: bash .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/scratch/synthesis/run-all.sh (main checkout); baseline in baseline.txt beside it. Source: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/synthesis.md
